verdict.rationale: Evidence pack contains only ROCm/AI-ecosystem documentation and generic product feature bullets (AV1 codec, FSR, Anti-Lag, Smart Access Memory); there are no vendor gaming-performance claims (e.g., FPS figures) nor any independent game benchmark data to corroborate 4K high-refresh gaming performance. missing for 10: vendor 4K/high-refresh FPS claims, independent game benchmark results, comparison to competitor performance.
